answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 13942 Country: India Title: If previously some person induldge in haram activity and he has given up all these activity,now he has given up these activity but he is getting income from the investment made by haram income ,is it OK to eat from this income? Question: If previously some person induldge in haram activity and he has given up all these activity,now he has given up these activity but he is getting income from the investment made by haram income ,is it OK to eat from this income? Answer ID: 13942 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1017/1017=M/1430) By haram if you mean wealth obtained through bribe, usurping and interest, one is asked to return all these haram wealth to their owners. If the owners are no more alive, he should return the same to the heirs. If there are no heirs or they are untraced after due efforts, he should give such wealth in charity to the poor and needy. But, the halal wealth earned through haram wealth will not be regarded as haram . Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
